analysis: Documentation-only batch. docs/architecture/model-autopilot.md head 151, 176-210, 273-276, 288-292 documents selected-model recovery. Recovery queues selected models that an operation unloaded and may evict unheld adopted Autopilot slots. Eviction is bounded by victim rules: min_dwell, no per-model lease, an idle threshold and no request in flight. Adoption release occurs 10 minutes after a hold expires or waiting begins. Pins, holds and the ordinary selection are protected; this is invariant 10. The doc also notes that saved enabled_models edits apply only at restart or a committed switch. docs/provider/cli-reference.md head 926-932 documents drain behavior when the coordinator is disconnected: drain finishes without an acknowledgement after 10 s. The text says the disconnect already cancelled accepted work. Shutdown waits up to 15 s per model unload and then leaves native retirement to process exit. Head 998-1013 documents new status lines. None of these changes touches attestation, E2E encryption (A-001, A-003), tokens (A-008), App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053) or cache storage (T-041). Recovery is operator-local residency policy that favors the operator's selection over coordinator placements. It cannot widen serving: a released adoption refuses new requests as model_not_selected. Integration should verify the following in source not supplied here: (1) unloadAllModelsForShutdown leaves native memory with prompt or KV data only until process exit (T-028), with no new persistence; (2) a drain finishing without an acknowledgement cannot leave accepted work unaccounted for coordinator billing (platform-owned); (3) isProtectedFromRecoveryEviction and adoptionReleaseTime honor in-flight requests. No regression was identified from the docs alone.
